paragraphs: Rav Kahana bar (Rav) Neḥemyah, Yevamot (71b). In Seder Ta'aniyot (24b): bar Rav Neḥunya, Rav Yehudah's attendant, who removed one of Rav Yehudah's shoes, and rain came.
